newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alex. Brown cuts Atmel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alex. Brown cuts Atmel.

text.p: Alex. Brown said it downgraded Atmel Corp to market perform from buy.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.

-- Wednesday, Atmel said that its second quarter results would be below expectations. Atmel said it expects revenues for the quarter ending June 30 to be about 10 percent below the $252.9 million it reported in the first quarter. Profits are expected to be about 30 percent below the $38.7 million or $0.38 a share it posted in the first quarter.
